# TravAI Skill Changelog

## v1.0 — Initial Release (2026-03-25)

Search and book flights and hotels, pay with crypto or card — all through natural conversation.

### Core capabilities

- Flight search with multi-airport parallel search support
- Hotel/stay search with flexible location anchors (city, address, landmark, airport)
- Full booking flow: search -> pricing -> traveller details -> payment
- Crypto payments (NEAR, USDC, and more via 1Click) and card payments (Stripe)
- Hotel photo gallery with interactive viewer

### Search intelligence

- Nearby airports database covering 200+ cities worldwide
- Smart search strategy: parallel searches across airports, flexible date matrix (+/-2 days), auto-fallback on zero results
- Direct-flight filtering support

### Agent behaviours

- Structured flight results display: Cheapest / Fastest / Other options with summary and best-pick recommendation
- Proactive warnings: next-day arrivals, short connections, missing baggage, non-refundable fares
- Price intelligence: cross-date comparison, baggage fee traps
- Train alternative suggestions for short-haul routes (<600km)

### Payment support

- Crypto: token selection grouped by blockchain, exact amount instructions, refund wallet collection
- Card: Stripe checkout with full URL passthrough

### Support

- Changes and cancellations via support@travai.tech or https://t.me/travaiofficial
- Troubleshooting table for common API errors
- Live OpenAPI schema as source of truth for any discrepancies
